description: TERRA//ECHO is a technology-driven team tackling NASA’s “Dancing with the SARs” challenge. We’re interested in Earth observation, SAR remote sensing, geospatial analysis, AI/ML, and turning satellite data into clear insights about Earth's surface changes. We welcome curious, collaborative problem-solvers and seek teammates with skills in GIS/remote sensing, Python/data science, radar or image processing, frontend/UI design, and scientific communication.
